explication: Nethermind is a .NET Ethereum execution client. An operator connects to a running node through JSON-RPC; the client processes transactions and blocks using its execution and state layers, participates in consensus and network synchronization, and exposes results and node health. The README also documents snap sync, plugins, L2 support, and witness capture/replay. The tree and excerpts show selected implementation points rather than the complete runtime wiring, so several documented subsystem connections are shown without source-level call evidence.
